snippet.title: PAYDAY 3: Party Powder Heist - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Set in a crumbling mob warehouse in NYC’s underbelly, Party Powder is a high-stakes heist playable in stealth or loud that focuses on strategy and replayability — feeling bold? Fire up the lab and cook your own product to truly rake it in — if you can survive the heat. The Party Powder heist arrives in PAYDAY 3 on the 26th of May, 2025.
